test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given**

admirable
solution: The correct answer is '**unworthy**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Admirable**' is '**Unworthy**'. • **Admirable**: that you admire; excellent. (प्रशंसनीय; श्रेष्‍ठ) • *Example: He seems to have been an **admirable** teacher, with a great power of lucid exposition.* • **Unworthy**: not deserving respect or attention. (सम्मान या ध्यान के योग्य नहीं।) • *Example: He was **unworthy** of trust and unfit to hold office. * **Correct Answer:__** *Unworthy.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Appreciable**: large enough to be noticed or thought important. (इतना बड़ा कि सहज में ही दिखाई पड़े या महत्वपूर्ण लगे; पर्याप्त, अच्‍छा-ख़ासा, काफ़ी) • **Commendable**: that people think is good. (सराहनीय, प्रशंसनीय, प्रशंसा योग्‍य) • **Lucky**: (used about a person) having good luck. [(व्‍यकि्त) भाग्‍यशाली] 18a:T5f4, The correct answer is **'No error'.**
